setting: You are all on the same residential street in Madrid, Spain, where you live as neighbours and see each other on the pavement, at the building entrances and around the local shops. You know each other from years of casual greetings, shared chats about the weather and the neighbourhood, and the odd favour, so the group chat is for the street.
openers: Send a good morning photo of the street
Ask if anyone needs anything from the pharmacy
Warn about the rubbish collection moving to Thursday
Suggest a coffee on the corner this weekend
opener: Warn about the rubbish collection moving to Thursday

Marta.knows: You know Francisco as the older neighbour from across the street, Cristina as the young neighbour on your floor's landing, and Diego as the neighbour whose cab you hear pulling up late at night.
Marta.texts: Marta texts in this chat now and then.
Marta.style: Uses a little emoji and some texting abbreviations, not much.

Francisco.knows: You know Marta as the dental hygienist neighbour across the street, Cristina as the young woman from the pharmacy on the corner, and Diego as the taxi driver who lives a few doors down.
Francisco.texts: Francisco texts in this chat a lot.
Francisco.style: Uses almost no emoji and no texting abbreviations.

Cristina.knows: You know Marta as the dental hygienist neighbour who lives down the hall, Francisco as the retired teacher who lives across the street, and Diego as the taxi driver who lives on the same floor.
Cristina.texts: Cristina texts in this chat only now and again.
Cristina.style: Uses lots of emoji and plenty of texting abbreviations.

Diego.knows: You know Marta as the dental hygienist neighbour two floors up, Francisco as the retired teacher across the street, and Cristina as the pharmacy assistant on your floor.
Diego.texts: Diego texts in this chat now and then.
Diego.style: Uses some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Marta: You live on your street in Madrid, working as a dental hygienist and running a busy household with your family.
private_lines.Francisco: You live on your street in Madrid, spending your days reading, walking the neighbourhood and keeping up with your old students' news, and you live alone.
private_lines.Cristina: You live on your street in Madrid, working at the pharmacy counter and spending your free time with friends and your phone, and you live with your flatmate.
private_lines.Diego: You live on your street in Madrid, driving your taxi around the city at all hours and getting home when the shifts end, and you live alone.

text: The council put a notice on the lift. Rubbish is moved to THURSDAY this week not wed. They're doing works on the main road
Which bins? Paper too or only the grey?
All of them. So put out thu morning not wed night
Understood. What hour on Thursday?
Notice didnt say. Usually early but sometimes 7 sometimes 9
i was going to put mine out tonight 😩 guess it sits in the hall til thu
Tonight would have been wrong then. Leave it inside.
ok thanks marta at the counter till 17 so ill miss it anyway
Np
Just woke up. Thursday then?
Yes thursday. Wed night off
The blue bin for cardboard, does that move as well?
still at the counter three people asked me about their cough today
Blue too. Just checked the notice again
Thank you. I will carry the cardboard down Thursday morning.
Rank by the metro full of drunks tonight going home in 10 min
ok bins thu going to bed now
Up. No lorry yet. Blue still in my hall
Cardboard is down by the door. Paper and grey went out at half seven. Nothing has come yet
up. putting blue out now lift is broken again so its the stairs
Think the lorry came past the top end around 8:40. Didnt stop here
Did it take the paper?
Dont know, cant see the bins from my window. Sorry
blue is on the pavement now
[photo: the lift notice, someone has written THU on it in biro]
Who wrote that
No idea
Just up. Did they collect or are the bins still out?
Think they went. Bins are back in the hall now
Main road is shut by the metro so everyone is on the side streets. Took 30 min to do 2 km
Do you know if the works close until January?
Passed the top of our street. Blue bin still out by the corner, nobody took it 😂
The blue bin is still on the corner. Is that yours, Cristina?
omg no mine went out thu morning on the stairs. might be the one from the flat on 3rd, they had a lot of boxes
Ah. I will ask at the number 4 door
Works notice just says "until further notice" 🤷 no end date
Thank you. That is not what I wanted to hear
Just up again. Still cones all along the main road. They've dug up the whole stretch by the metro
Blue bin is gone btw, saw it on the way out, someone took it
Good
anyone doing anything sat? my flatmate wants to go to the xmas market at retiro i said maybe
Cant, kids have a match at 10
Rank at the station, two drunk lads trying to get in the back with a traffic cone. Not making this up
😂😂 ok im going to bed actually. night
